summary.en: A game you play with your face — a workout you actually want to repeat.
summary.jp: 顔だけで遊ぶゲーム。ふつうは続かない運動を、続けたくなる形にした。

mine: Designed a face-tracking game meant to double as a workout

challenge.en: Facial exercise and rehab tools feel clinical; games that use the camera usually feel creepy or finicky. We needed play that reads as joy in thirty seconds, keeps video on-device, and teaches itself without a tutorial wall.
challenge.jp: 顔の運動やリハビリは臨床っぽく、カメラを使うゲームは気味悪さや反応の悪さが先に立つ。30 秒で喜びとして読め、映像は端末内に留め、説明書なしで伝わる遊びが必要だった。

solution.en: Kao Game maps mouth, cheeks, and gaze into mini-games that reward clear motion, not precision suffering. Detection stays local; the decisive move was designing rules players can infer from what moves on screen — then cutting anything that needed a sentence.
solution.jp: 口・頬・視線を、はっきり動いたときに報いるミニゲームへ写す。検出は端末内。決定打は、画面の動きからルールを推測できる設計にし、一文が必要なものを削ること。

cardLine.en: Your face is the controller — short sessions, no hardware.
cardLine.jp: 顔がコントローラ。短いセッション、デバイス不要。
